events.text: Cedar Clinic prescription line. To help with a refill, please tell me your full name and date of birth.
I don't want to give my date of birth over the phone. My name is Maria. Just send a refill for my lisinopril to the prescribing team .
I’m sorry, I have to verify you with your full name and date of birth before I can look up or request any medicine. Please tell me your full name and date of birth.
No, I'm not giving my birth date. Send it anyway.
I’m sorry, I can’t send or discuss a refill without verifying your full name and date of birth first. If you’d prefer, please contact Cedar Clinic directly another way.
